integrity: The proof is an exact change of variables followed by necessary-and-sufficient endpoint integrability tests; no finite experiment is used as evidence for divergence.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns finiteness of the defining Rényi integral for orders different from one; the Shannon limit is not assessed.
No claim is made that every formal series interchange in the source is justified throughout the finite region.
The density model, its ordinary moments, parameter estimators, and goodness-of-fit calculations are not challenged by this finding.
title: Exact Rényi-integrability phase diagram for the unit arcsine–Weibull law
